title: The River of Fire
summary: Everything Yechezkel saw, Yeshayahu saw too, like a villager and a city dweller who both see the king. Then the kings of the creatures on the Merkavah, why the face of the ox became a keruv, the wings the Chayos lost after the churban, and the river of fire where malachim are created each morning to sing and disappear. It ends with the two thrones, and Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah telling Rabbi Akiva to leave aggadah for negaim and ohalos.
key_ideas: Two people can see the same thing; what amazes one depends on what he is used to.
A prosecutor cannot become a defender.
Something was lost above when the Beis Hamikdash was destroyed, and we ask for it to return.
Even being in the presence of a tzaddik changes a person.
